Name: Marnie Actually Works
Author: Skyking2020
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It seemed like every time I needed Marnie, she was off being lazy. Nothing infuriated me more than seeing her just standing in her bedroom while my animals starved or some other farm emergency was taking place. With this mod, Marnie will now be behind the counter of her shop Monday and Tuesday along with the rest of her normal schedule. Nothing else was changed other than adjusting those two entries.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]NOTE: There used to be a mod called "Get to Work Marnie" or something along those lines. I can no longer find it. I didn't want a mod that did more than adjust her schedule, so I made this mod for personal use, but I thought maybe others may like it. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is my first Stardew mod. Go easy on me.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you like the mod, please give me an endorsement. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Does what it says on the tin. Marnie will be working Mondays and Tuesdays now.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod requires Stardew 1.6+[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Install both requirements first, then extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Marnie Actually Works
Manifest.Description: Changes Marnie's Monday and Tuesday schedule so she works at Marnie's Animal Shop.
Manifest.Author: Skyking2020
